## Specification

### Component: Dropdown menu

A list of actions on a trigger, following the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern. The panel is a `popover="manual"` element in the top layer (shared `FloatingContent`: `useFloating` + `usePresence`).

#### Anatomy
```
<DropdownMenu>                         context: open state, ids, trigger ref
  <DropdownMenuTrigger />              button: aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded, aria-controls
  <DropdownMenuContent>                <div class="ui-floating ui-menu" role="menu" popover="manual" data-state data-side>
    <DropdownMenuLabel />              .ui-menu-label
    <DropdownMenuGroup />              role="group"
    <DropdownMenuItem />               role="menuitem"  (icon, shortcut, variant, disabled, inset, asChild, onSelect)
    <DropdownMenuCheckboxItem />       role="menuitemcheckbox" aria-checked  (checked | defaultChecked, onCheckedChange)
    <DropdownMenuRadioGroup />         role="group" (value | defaultValue, onValueChange)
      <DropdownMenuRadioItem />        role="menuitemradio" aria-checked  (value)
    <DropdownMenuSeparator />          role="separator"
    <DropdownMenuSub>
      <DropdownMenuSubTrigger />       role="menuitem" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded, chevron
      <DropdownMenuSubContent />       nested role="menu" panel, placement right-start
```
Every item carries `data-menu-owner` = the id of its own panel, so a submenu rendered inside its parent's DOM never mixes items in roving focus.

#### Props
- `DropdownMenu`: `open`, `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange`.
- `DropdownMenuContent`: `placement` (default `bottom-start`), `align`, `offset` (6), `matchWidth`, native div props.
- `DropdownMenuItem`: `icon`, `shortcut`, `variant` (`default | destructive`), `disabled`, `inset`, `asChild`, `onSelect(event)`; `event.preventDefault()` keeps the menu open.
- Sub: `DropdownMenuSub` takes `open`, `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange`; `DropdownMenuSubContent` placement defaults to `right-start`, offset 4.

#### Behaviour
- Trigger click toggles; click-initiated opens focus the panel, keyboard opens (Enter/Space/ArrowDown) focus the first item and ArrowUp the last.
- Items have `tabIndex=-1`; `useRovingFocus` (selector = the panel's own items) moves focus with ArrowUp/Down (wraps), Home/End and typeahead. Disabled items (`data-disabled`) are skipped.
- Highlight follows the pointer: `pointermove` on an item (not touch) focuses it; `data-highlighted` mirrors focus. Leaving the panel moves focus to the panel to clear it.
- Enter, Space or click chooses an item: `onSelect` runs, then the whole menu closes unless the event was default-prevented. Checkbox and radio items update their state first.
- Esc and outside pointerdown (`useDismiss`) close it; Tab closes it. Focus returns to the trigger, except after an outside click.
- Submenu: pointer over the sub trigger opens it after 100ms; ArrowRight/Enter/Space opens it and focuses its first item. Hovering a sibling item closes it unless the pointer is inside the "grace" triangle between where it left the trigger and the submenu (400ms), so a diagonal move does not close it. Leaving the trigger elsewhere closes it after 300ms. ArrowLeft or Esc closes only the submenu and refocuses its trigger. Only one submenu per panel is open.
- Selecting inside a submenu closes the whole menu.

#### Visual rules
- Panel: `--ui-surface-raised`, 1px `--ui-border`, `--radius-lg`, `--ui-shadow-lg`, padding 4px, min width 8rem, max height `100dvh − 16px` (scrolls).
- Item: 32px high, padding 0 8px, gap 8px, `--radius-md`, 14px; highlighted = `--ui-accent` / `--ui-accent-foreground`; disabled opacity .5.
- Icon 16px `--ui-muted-foreground`; shortcut 12px muted on the right; check/radio indicator in a 16px slot at the left (items get 32px left padding).
- Destructive: `--ui-destructive-text`, highlight tinted with 6% `--ui-destructive`.
- Label: 12px/500 muted, padding 6px 8px. Separator: 1px `--ui-border`, margin 4px −4px.
- Submenu panel is nudged up 5px so its first item lines up with the trigger.

#### Motion
- Open: `ui-pop-in` 150ms `--ui-ease-out` from the anchor side, 4px travel, scale .96. Close: `ui-pop-out` 160ms `--ui-ease-in`.

#### Accessibility
- Roles and aria-checked as above; the menu is `aria-labelledby` its trigger; submenu panels are labelled by their sub trigger.
- Touch: taps select; hover-intent logic ignores touch pointers; `cursor: pointer` under `(hover: none)` so iOS dispatches clicks.

#### Acceptance checks
- Menu sits below the trigger (gap 6px) and flips above near the bottom edge.
- ArrowDown/Up/Home/End/typeahead move focus; Enter/Space choose; Esc closes and refocuses the trigger.
- Hover highlights; submenu opens on hover and ArrowRight, closes with ArrowLeft; selecting a sub item closes everything.
- Checkbox/radio state updates; `preventDefault` in `onSelect` keeps the menu open.
- No axe violations in light and dark with the menu (and submenu) open.

### `ui/components/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  forwardRef,
  useCallback,
  useId,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  type ButtonHTMLAttributes,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type MouseEvent,
  type PointerEvent,
  type ReactNode,
  type RefObject,
} from 'react';
import { Slot } from '../../lib/slot';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useDismiss } from '../../hooks/use-dismiss';
import { useRovingFocus } from '../../hooks/use-roving-focus';
import { FloatingContent, type FloatingContentProps } from '../popover/floating-content';
import {
  MenuPanelContext,
  MenuRootContext,
  focusItem,
  isOwnEvent,
  ownedItems,
  useMenuRoot,
  type ActiveSub,
  type OpenMethod,
} from './menu-context';

export interface DropdownMenuProps {
  /** Controlled open state. */
  open?: boolean;
  /** Initial open state when uncontrolled. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  /** Called when the menu asks to open or close. */
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  children?: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * DropdownMenu — a list of actions on a trigger (WAI-ARIA menu button).
 * Arrow keys, Home/End and typeahead move between items; Enter or Space
 * chooses; Esc closes and returns focus to the trigger.
 */
export function DropdownMenu({ open: openProp, defaultOpen = false, onOpenChange, children }: DropdownMenuProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useControllableState({ value: openProp, defaultValue: defaultOpen, onChange: onOpenChange });
  const id = useId();
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const openMethod = useRef<OpenMethod>('pointer');
  const skipFocusReturn = useRef(false);
  const closeMenu = useCallback(() => setOpen(false), [setOpen]);
  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({
      open,
      setOpen,
      triggerRef,
      triggerId: `${id}-trigger`,
      contentId: `${id}-content`,
      openMethod,
      skipFocusReturn,
      closeMenu,
    }),
    [open, setOpen, id, closeMenu],
  );
  return <MenuRootContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</MenuRootContext.Provider>;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface DropdownMenuTriggerProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  asChild?: boolean;
}

/** Opens the menu. Use `asChild` to make your own <Button> the trigger. */
export const DropdownMenuTrigger = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, DropdownMenuTriggerProps>(function DropdownMenuTrigger(
  { asChild, onClick, onKeyDown, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useMenuRoot('DropdownMenuTrigger');
  const composed = useComposedRefs(ref, ctx.triggerRef as RefObject<HTMLButtonElement | null>);
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'button';
  return (
    <Comp
      ref={composed}
      id={ctx.triggerId}
      type={asChild ? undefined : 'button'}
      aria-haspopup="menu"
      aria-expanded={ctx.open}
      aria-controls={ctx.open ? ctx.contentId : undefined}
      data-state={ctx.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
      onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        onClick?.(e);
        if (e.defaultPrevented) return;
        // detail 0 = activated from the keyboard (Enter / Space)
        ctx.openMethod.current = e.detail === 0 ? 'keyboard' : 'pointer';
        ctx.setOpen(!ctx.open);
      }}
      onKeyDown={(e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        onKeyDown?.(e);
        if (e.defaultPrevented) return;
        if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
          e.preventDefault();
          ctx.openMethod.current = e.key === 'ArrowUp' ? 'keyboard-last' : 'keyboard';
          ctx.setOpen(true);
        }
      }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export type DropdownMenuContentProps = Omit<
  FloatingContentProps,
  'open' | 'anchorRef' | 'arrow' | 'onOpened' | 'returnFocusRef' | 'skipFocusReturnRef'
>;

export const DropdownMenuContent = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, DropdownMenuContentProps>(function DropdownMenuContent(
  { placement = 'bottom-start', offset = 6, className, children, onKeyDown, onPointerLeave, ...props },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const ctx = useMenuRoot('DropdownMenuContent');
  const ownerId = useId();
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, panelRef);
  const activeSub = useRef<ActiveSub | null>(null);
  const panel = useMemo(() => ({ ownerId, activeSub }), [ownerId]);
  const rove = useRovingFocus({ itemSelector: ownedItems(ownerId) });

  useDismiss(ctx.open, [panelRef, ctx.triggerRef], (reason) => {
    ctx.skipFocusReturn.current = reason === 'outside';
    ctx.setOpen(false);
  });

  return (
    <FloatingContent
      ref={ref}
      open={ctx.open}
      anchorRef={ctx.triggerRef}
      placement={placement}
      offset={offset}
      role="menu"
      id={ctx.contentId}
      tabIndex={-1}
      aria-orientation="vertical"
      aria-labelledby={ctx.triggerRef.current?.id || ctx.triggerId}
      className={cn('ui-menu', className)}
      returnFocusRef={ctx.triggerRef}
      skipFocusReturnRef={ctx.skipFocusReturn}
      onOpened={(el) => {
        const method = ctx.openMethod.current;
        if (method === 'pointer') el.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        else focusItem(el, ownerId, method === 'keyboard-last' ? 'last' : 'first');
        // A programmatic open (defaultOpen, controlled) has no gesture: stay on the panel next time
        ctx.openMethod.current = 'pointer';
      }}
      onKeyDown={(e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onKeyDown?.(e);
        if (e.defaultPrevented || !isOwnEvent(e)) return;
        if (e.key === 'Tab') {
          // A menu is one tab stop: Tab closes it and returns focus to the trigger
          e.preventDefault();
          ctx.closeMenu();
          return;
        }
        rove(e);
      }}
      onPointerLeave={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onPointerLeave?.(e);
        // The highlight follows the pointer, so it clears when the pointer leaves
        const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
        if (e.pointerType !== 'touch' && !activeSub.current && active?.dataset.menuOwner === ownerId) {
          e.currentTarget.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        }
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      <MenuPanelContext.Provider value={panel}>{children}</MenuPanelContext.Provider>
    </FloatingContent>
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/dropdown-menu/menu-context.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { createContext, useContext, type MutableRefObject, type RefObject } from 'react';

/** How the menu was opened: decides where focus lands first. */
export type OpenMethod = 'pointer' | 'keyboard' | 'keyboard-last';

export interface MenuRootContextValue {
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  triggerRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  triggerId: string;
  contentId: string;
  openMethod: MutableRefObject<OpenMethod>;
  /** Set true before closing from an outside click, so focus is not pulled back to the trigger. */
  skipFocusReturn: MutableRefObject<boolean>;
  /** Close the whole menu (an item was chosen). */
  closeMenu: () => void;
}

export const MenuRootContext = createContext<MenuRootContextValue | null>(null);

export function useMenuRoot(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(MenuRootContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <DropdownMenu>.`);
  return ctx;
}

/** The open submenu of one menu panel, so hovering another item can close it. */
export interface ActiveSub {
  id: string;
  triggerEl: HTMLElement | null;
  close: () => void;
  getPanelRect: () => DOMRect | null;
  /** Where the pointer was when it left the submenu trigger (for the grace triangle). */
  getExit: () => { x: number; y: number; t: number } | null;
}

/** One `role="menu"` panel: the root menu or a submenu. */
export interface MenuPanelContextValue {
  /** Items carry data-menu-owner so nested panels never mix their items. */
  ownerId: string;
  activeSub: MutableRefObject<ActiveSub | null>;
}

export const MenuPanelContext = createContext<MenuPanelContextValue | null>(null);

export function useMenuPanel(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(MenuPanelContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <DropdownMenuContent>.`);
  return ctx;
}

/** Selector for the items that belong to one panel. */
export const ownedItems = (ownerId: string) => `[data-menu-owner="${ownerId}"]`;

/** Focus the first (or last) enabled item of a panel. */
export function focusItem(panel: HTMLElement, ownerId: string, which: 'first' | 'last') {
  const items = Array.from(panel.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(ownedItems(ownerId))).filter(
    (el) => !el.hasAttribute('data-disabled'),
  );
  const target = which === 'first' ? items[0] : items[items.length - 1];
  (target ?? panel).focus({ preventScroll: true });
}

/** True when the event came from this panel itself, not from a submenu nested inside it. */
export function isOwnEvent(e: { target: EventTarget | null; currentTarget: EventTarget | null }) {
  return (e.target as Element | null)?.closest('[role="menu"]') === e.currentTarget;
}

/* Grace area: moving diagonally from a submenu trigger toward its panel must
   not close the submenu when the pointer crosses the items in between. */

const GRACE_MS = 400;

function inTriangle(p: { x: number; y: number }, a: { x: number; y: number }, b: { x: number; y: number }, c: { x: number; y: number }) {
  const sign = (p1: typeof p, p2: typeof p, p3: typeof p) => (p1.x - p3.x) * (p2.y - p3.y) - (p2.x - p3.x) * (p1.y - p3.y);
  const d1 = sign(p, a, b);
  const d2 = sign(p, b, c);
  const d3 = sign(p, c, a);
  const neg = d1 < 0 || d2 < 0 || d3 < 0;
  const pos = d1 > 0 || d2 > 0 || d3 > 0;
  return !(neg && pos);
}

/** Is the pointer heading toward the open submenu? */
export function pointerInGrace(sub: ActiveSub, x: number, y: number) {
  const exit = sub.getExit();
  const rect = sub.getPanelRect();
  if (!exit || !rect || Date.now() - exit.t > GRACE_MS) return false;
  const toRight = rect.left >= exit.x;
  const edgeX = toRight ? rect.left : rect.right;
  return inTriangle({ x, y }, exit, { x: edgeX, y: rect.top }, { x: edgeX, y: rect.bottom });
}
```

### `ui/components/dropdown-menu/menu-items.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  forwardRef,
  useContext,
  useState,
  type FocusEvent,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type MouseEvent,
  type PointerEvent,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { Slot } from '../../lib/slot';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { pointerInGrace, useMenuPanel, useMenuRoot, type MenuPanelContextValue } from './menu-context';

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/**
 * Highlight follows the pointer: moving over an item focuses it, and the
 * highlighted state mirrors focus (so the keyboard and the pointer share one
 * highlight). Also closes a sibling's open submenu unless the pointer is on
 * its way there. Returns true when the pointer move should be ignored.
 */
export function pointerMovedOverItem(panel: MenuPanelContextValue, e: PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) {
  const sub = panel.activeSub.current;
  if (!sub || sub.triggerEl === e.currentTarget) return false;
  if (pointerInGrace(sub, e.clientX, e.clientY)) return true;
  sub.close();
  return false;
}

export function useItemHighlight(disabled: boolean | undefined) {
  const panel = useMenuPanel('DropdownMenuItem');
  const [highlighted, setHighlighted] = useState(false);
  return {
    highlighted,
    onPointerMove: (e: PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
      if (disabled || e.pointerType === 'touch') return;
      if (pointerMovedOverItem(panel, e)) return;
      if (document.activeElement !== e.currentTarget) e.currentTarget.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    },
    onFocus: () => setHighlighted(true),
    onBlur: () => setHighlighted(false),
  };
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

interface ItemBaseProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'onSelect'> {
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Called when the item is chosen. Call `event.preventDefault()` to keep the menu open. */
  onSelect?: (event: Event) => void;
  /** Render the child element instead (a link, a Next.js <Link>). */
  asChild?: boolean;
}

/** Props shared by every selectable item: roving tabindex, highlight, Enter/Space/click → select. */
function useSelectableItem({
  disabled,
  onSelect,
  onClick,
  onKeyDown,
  onPointerMove,
  onFocus,
  onBlur,
}: Pick<ItemBaseProps, 'disabled' | 'onSelect' | 'onClick' | 'onKeyDown' | 'onPointerMove' | 'onFocus' | 'onBlur'>) {
  const root = useMenuRoot('DropdownMenuItem');
  const panel = useMenuPanel('DropdownMenuItem');
  const highlight = useItemHighlight(disabled);

  const select = () => {
    const event = new Event('menu.select', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true });
    onSelect?.(event);
    if (!event.defaultPrevented) root.closeMenu();
  };

  return {
    highlighted: highlight.highlighted,
    props: {
      tabIndex: -1,
      'data-menu-owner': panel.ownerId,
      'data-highlighted': highlight.highlighted ? '' : undefined,
      'data-disabled': disabled ? '' : undefined,
      'aria-disabled': disabled || undefined,
      onPointerMove: (e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onPointerMove?.(e);
        if (!e.defaultPrevented) highlight.onPointerMove(e);
      },
      onFocus: (e: FocusEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onFocus?.(e);
        highlight.onFocus();
      },
      onBlur: (e: FocusEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onBlur?.(e);
        highlight.onBlur();
      },
      onClick: (e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onClick?.(e);
        if (!e.defaultPrevented && !disabled) select();
      },
      onKeyDown: (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onKeyDown?.(e);
        if (e.defaultPrevented || disabled) return;
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          e.currentTarget.click();
        }
      },
    },
  };
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface DropdownMenuItemProps extends ItemBaseProps {
  /** Leading icon (16px). */
  icon?: ReactNode;
  /** Keyboard shortcut hint on the right, e.g. "⌘K". */
  shortcut?: ReactNode;
  /** `destructive` colours the item red. */
  variant?: 'default' | 'destructive';
  /** Indent to line up with items that have a check or radio indicator. */
  inset?: boolean;
}

/** A single action. */
export const DropdownMenuItem = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, DropdownMenuItemProps>(function DropdownMenuItem(
  {
    asChild,
    icon,
    shortcut,
    variant = 'default',
    inset,
    disabled,
    onSelect,
    onClick,
    onKeyDown,
    onPointerMove,
    onFocus,
    onBlur,
    className,
    children,
    ...others
  },
  ref,
) {
  const { props } = useSelectableItem({ disabled, onSelect, onClick, onKeyDown, onPointerMove, onFocus, onBlur });
  const classes = cn(
    'ui-menu-item',
    variant === 'destructive' && 'ui-menu-item-destructive',
    inset && 'ui-menu-item-inset',
    className,
  );
  if (asChild) {
    return (
      <Slot ref={ref} role="menuitem" className={classes} {...props} {...others}>
        {children}
      </Slot>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div ref={ref} role="menuitem" className={classes} {...props} {...others}>
      {icon != null && <span className="ui-menu-icon">{icon}</span>}
      {children}
      {shortcut != null && <span className="ui-menu-shortcut">{shortcut}</span>}
    </div>
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface DropdownMenuCheckboxItemProps extends ItemBaseProps {
  /** Controlled checked state. */
  checked?: boolean;
  defaultChecked?: boolean;
  onCheckedChange?: (checked: boolean) => void;
  shortcut?: ReactNode;
}

/** An item that toggles an option. Choosing it closes the menu unless `onSelect` prevents it. */
export const DropdownMenuCheckboxItem = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, DropdownMenuCheckboxItemProps>(
  function DropdownMenuCheckboxItem(
    { checked: checkedProp, defaultChecked = false, onCheckedChange, shortcut, disabled, onSelect, className, children, asChild: _asChild, ...rest },
    ref,
  ) {
    const [checked, setChecked] = useControllableState({
      value: checkedProp,
      defaultValue: defaultChecked,
      onChange: onCheckedChange,
    });
    const { onClick, onKeyDown, onPointerMove, onFocus, onBlur, ...others } = rest;
    const { props } = useSelectableItem({
      disabled,
      onClick,
      onKeyDown,
      onPointerMove,
      onFocus,
      onBlur,
      onSelect: (event) => {
        setChecked(!checked);
        onSelect?.(event);
      },
    });
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="menuitemcheckbox"
        aria-checked={checked}
        data-state={checked ? 'checked' : 'unchecked'}
        className={cn('ui-menu-item ui-menu-item-check', className)}
        {...props}
        {...others}
      >
        <span className="ui-menu-indicator" aria-hidden="true">
          {checked && <Icon name="check" size={14} />}
        </span>
        {children}
        {shortcut != null && <span className="ui-menu-shortcut">{shortcut}</span>}
      </div>
    );
  },
);

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

interface RadioGroupContextValue {
  value: string | undefined;
  onValueChange: (value: string) => void;
}

const RadioGroupContext = createContext<RadioGroupContextValue | null>(null);

export interface DropdownMenuRadioGroupProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** Controlled selected value. */
  value?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void;
}

/** A group of mutually exclusive items. */
export const DropdownMenuRadioGroup = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, DropdownMenuRadioGroupProps>(
  function DropdownMenuRadioGroup({ value: valueProp, defaultValue, onValueChange, className, ...props }, ref) {
    const [value, setValue] = useControllableState<string | undefined>({
      value: valueProp,
      defaultValue,
      onChange: (v) => v !== undefined && onValueChange?.(v),
    });
    return (
      <RadioGroupContext.Provider value={{ value, onValueChange: setValue }}>
        <div ref={ref} role="group" className={cn('ui-menu-group', className)} {...props} />
      </RadioGroupContext.Provider>
    );
  },
);

export interface DropdownMenuRadioItemProps extends ItemBaseProps {
  /** The value this item selects. */
  value: string;
  shortcut?: ReactNode;
}

export const DropdownMenuRadioItem = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, DropdownMenuRadioItemProps>(
  function DropdownMenuRadioItem(
    { value, shortcut, disabled, onSelect, className, children, asChild: _asChild, ...rest },
    ref,
  ) {
    const group = useContext(RadioGroupContext);
    if (!group) throw new Error('<DropdownMenuRadioItem> must be used inside <DropdownMenuRadioGroup>.');
    const checked = group.value === value;
    const { onClick, onKeyDown, onPointerMove, onFocus, onBlur, ...others } = rest;
    const { props } = useSelectableItem({
      disabled,
      onClick,
      onKeyDown,
      onPointerMove,
      onFocus,
      onBlur,
      onSelect: (event) => {
        group.onValueChange(value);
        onSelect?.(event);
      },
    });
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="menuitemradio"
        aria-checked={checked}
        data-state={checked ? 'checked' : 'unchecked'}
        className={cn('ui-menu-item ui-menu-item-check', className)}
        {...props}
        {...others}
      >
        <span className="ui-menu-indicator" aria-hidden="true">
          {checked && <span className="ui-menu-dot" />}
        </span>
        {children}
        {shortcut != null && <span className="ui-menu-shortcut">{shortcut}</span>}
      </div>
    );
  },
);

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/** A small heading above a group of items. */
export const DropdownMenuLabel = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & { inset?: boolean }>(
  function DropdownMenuLabel({ className, inset, ...props }, ref) {
    return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-menu-label', inset && 'ui-menu-item-inset', className)} {...props} />;
  },
);

export const DropdownMenuSeparator = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(
  function DropdownMenuSeparator({ className, ...props }, ref) {
    return <div ref={ref} role="separator" aria-orientation="horizontal" className={cn('ui-menu-separator', className)} {...props} />;
  },
);

/** Groups related items for assistive technology. Give it an aria-label. */
export const DropdownMenuGroup = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(
  function DropdownMenuGroup({ className, ...props }, ref) {
    return <div ref={ref} role="group" className={cn('ui-menu-group', className)} {...props} />;
  },
);
```

### `ui/components/dropdown-menu/menu-sub.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  forwardRef,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useId,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  type FocusEvent,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type MouseEvent,
  type MutableRefObject,
  type PointerEvent,
  type ReactNode,
  type RefObject,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useHoverIntent } from '../../hooks/use-hover-intent';
import { useRovingFocus } from '../../hooks/use-roving-focus';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { FloatingContent, type FloatingContentProps } from '../popover/floating-content';
import {
  MenuPanelContext,
  focusItem,
  isOwnEvent,
  ownedItems,
  useMenuPanel,
  useMenuRoot,
  type ActiveSub,
  type OpenMethod,
} from './menu-context';
import { pointerMovedOverItem, useItemHighlight } from './menu-items';

const OPEN_DELAY = 100;
const CLOSE_DELAY = 300;

interface SubContextValue {
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  triggerRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  contentRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  triggerId: string;
  contentId: string;
  openMethod: MutableRefObject<OpenMethod>;
  exit: MutableRefObject<{ x: number; y: number; t: number } | null>;
  intent: ReturnType<typeof useHoverIntent>;
}

const SubContext = createContext<SubContextValue | null>(null);

function useSub(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(SubContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <DropdownMenuSub>.`);
  return ctx;
}

export interface DropdownMenuSubProps {
  /** Controlled open state. */
  open?: boolean;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  children?: ReactNode;
}

/** A nested menu. Opens to the side on hover (short intent delay) or ArrowRight. */
export function DropdownMenuSub({ open: openProp, defaultOpen = false, onOpenChange, children }: DropdownMenuSubProps) {
  const panel = useMenuPanel('DropdownMenuSub');
  const [open, setOpen] = useControllableState({ value: openProp, defaultValue: defaultOpen, onChange: onOpenChange });
  const id = useId();
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const contentRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const openMethod = useRef<OpenMethod>('pointer');
  const exit = useRef<SubContextValue['exit']['current']>(null);
  const intent = useHoverIntent();

  // Only one submenu is open per panel; the panel can close it when another item is hovered
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const record: ActiveSub = {
      id,
      triggerEl: triggerRef.current,
      close: () => setOpen(false),
      getPanelRect: () => contentRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect() ?? null,
      getExit: () => exit.current,
    };
    const previous = panel.activeSub.current;
    if (previous && previous.id !== id) previous.close();
    panel.activeSub.current = record;
    return () => {
      if (panel.activeSub.current === record) panel.activeSub.current = null;
    };
  }, [open, id, panel, setOpen]);

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({
      open,
      setOpen,
      triggerRef,
      contentRef,
      triggerId: `${id}-trigger`,
      contentId: `${id}-content`,
      openMethod,
      exit,
      intent,
    }),
    [open, setOpen, id, intent],
  );
  return <SubContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</SubContext.Provider>;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface DropdownMenuSubTriggerProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Leading icon (16px). */
  icon?: ReactNode;
  inset?: boolean;
}

/** The item that opens a submenu; shows a chevron. */
export const DropdownMenuSubTrigger = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, DropdownMenuSubTriggerProps>(
  function DropdownMenuSubTrigger(
    {
      disabled,
      icon,
      inset,
      className,
      children,
      onPointerMove,
      onPointerLeave,
      onClick,
      onKeyDown,
      onFocus,
      onBlur,
      ...props
    },
    forwardedRef,
  ) {
    const sub = useSub('DropdownMenuSubTrigger');
    const panel = useMenuPanel('DropdownMenuSubTrigger');
    const highlight = useItemHighlight(disabled);
    const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, sub.triggerRef as RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>);

    const openSub = (method: OpenMethod) => {
      sub.intent.cancel();
      sub.openMethod.current = method;
      sub.setOpen(true);
    };

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        id={sub.triggerId}
        role="menuitem"
        tabIndex={-1}
        aria-haspopup="menu"
        aria-expanded={sub.open}
        aria-controls={sub.open ? sub.contentId : undefined}
        aria-disabled={disabled || undefined}
        data-menu-owner={panel.ownerId}
        data-state={sub.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
        data-highlighted={highlight.highlighted ? '' : undefined}
        data-disabled={disabled ? '' : undefined}
        className={cn('ui-menu-item ui-menu-sub-trigger', inset && 'ui-menu-item-inset', className)}
        onPointerMove={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
          onPointerMove?.(e);
          if (e.defaultPrevented || disabled || e.pointerType === 'touch') return;
          if (pointerMovedOverItem(panel, e)) return;
          if (document.activeElement !== e.currentTarget) e.currentTarget.focus({ preventScroll: true });
          // Hover intent: open after a short pause, not on a fly-by
          if (sub.open) sub.intent.cancel();
          else sub.intent.start(() => openSub('pointer'), OPEN_DELAY);
        }}
        onPointerLeave={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
          onPointerLeave?.(e);
          if (disabled || e.pointerType === 'touch') return;
          sub.exit.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, t: Date.now() };
          if (sub.open) sub.intent.start(() => sub.setOpen(false), CLOSE_DELAY);
          else sub.intent.cancel();
        }}
        onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
          onClick?.(e);
          if (e.defaultPrevented || disabled) return;
          if (!sub.open) openSub('pointer');
        }}
        onKeyDown={(e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
          onKeyDown?.(e);
          if (e.defaultPrevented || disabled) return;
          if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            openSub('keyboard');
          }
        }}
        onFocus={(e: FocusEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
          onFocus?.(e);
          highlight.onFocus();
        }}
        onBlur={(e: FocusEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
          onBlur?.(e);
          highlight.onBlur();
        }}
        {...props}
      >
        {icon != null && <span className="ui-menu-icon">{icon}</span>}
        {children}
        <Icon name="chevron-right" className="ui-menu-chevron" />
      </div>
    );
  },
);

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export type DropdownMenuSubContentProps = Omit<
  FloatingContentProps,
  'open' | 'anchorRef' | 'arrow' | 'onOpened' | 'returnFocusRef' | 'skipFocusReturnRef'
>;

export const DropdownMenuSubContent = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, DropdownMenuSubContentProps>(
  function DropdownMenuSubContent(
    { placement = 'right-start', offset = 4, className, children, onKeyDown, onPointerEnter, ...props },
    forwardedRef,
  ) {
    const sub = useSub('DropdownMenuSubContent');
    const root = useMenuRoot('DropdownMenuSubContent');
    const ownerId = useId();
    const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, sub.contentRef as RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>);
    const activeSub = useRef<ActiveSub | null>(null);
    const panel = useMemo(() => ({ ownerId, activeSub }), [ownerId]);
    const rove = useRovingFocus({ itemSelector: ownedItems(ownerId) });

    return (
      <FloatingContent
        ref={ref}
        open={sub.open}
        anchorRef={sub.triggerRef}
        placement={placement}
        offset={offset}
        role="menu"
        id={sub.contentId}
        tabIndex={-1}
        aria-orientation="vertical"
        aria-labelledby={sub.triggerId}
        className={cn('ui-menu ui-menu-sub', className)}
        returnFocusRef={sub.triggerRef}
        onOpened={(el) => {
          if (sub.openMethod.current !== 'pointer') focusItem(el, ownerId, 'first');
          sub.openMethod.current = 'pointer';
        }}
        onPointerEnter={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
          onPointerEnter?.(e);
          sub.intent.cancel();
        }}
        onKeyDown={(e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
          onKeyDown?.(e);
          if (e.defaultPrevented || !isOwnEvent(e)) return;
          if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'Escape') {
            // Close just this level; preventDefault keeps Esc from also closing the root menu
            e.preventDefault();
            sub.setOpen(false);
            sub.triggerRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            return;
          }
          if (e.key === 'Tab') {
            e.preventDefault();
            root.closeMenu();
            return;
          }
          rove(e);
        }}
        {...props}
      >
        <MenuPanelContext.Provider value={panel}>{children}</MenuPanelContext.Provider>
      </FloatingContent>
    );
  },
);
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-dismiss.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, type RefObject } from 'react';

export type DismissReason = 'escape' | 'outside';

/**
 * Call `onDismiss` on Escape or a pointerdown outside every element in `refs`.
 * Used by popovers, menus, selects — anything non-modal that floats.
 */
export function useDismiss(
  enabled: boolean,
  refs: RefObject<Element | null>[],
  onDismiss: (reason: DismissReason) => void,
  { escape = true, outside = true }: { escape?: boolean; outside?: boolean } = {},
) {
  const cb = useRef(onDismiss);
  cb.current = onDismiss;
  const refsRef = useRef(refs);
  refsRef.current = refs;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (escape && e.key === 'Escape' && !e.defaultPrevented) {
        e.preventDefault();
        cb.current('escape');
      }
    };
    const onPointer = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as Node | null;
      if (!target) return;
      if (refsRef.current.some((r) => r.current?.contains(target))) return;
      cb.current('outside');
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    if (outside) document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointer, true);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onPointer, true);
    };
  }, [enabled, escape, outside]);
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-hover-intent.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';

/**
 * One cancellable timer for hover intent (tooltip delays, submenu open/close).
 * Starting a new timer replaces the previous one; it is cleared on unmount.
 *   const intent = useHoverIntent();
 *   intent.start(() => setOpen(true), 700);   intent.cancel();
 */
export function useHoverIntent() {
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);

  const cancel = useCallback(() => {
    clearTimeout(timer.current);
    timer.current = undefined;
  }, []);

  const start = useCallback(
    (fn: () => void, delay: number) => {
      cancel();
      if (delay <= 0) {
        fn();
        return;
      }
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        timer.current = undefined;
        fn();
      }, delay);
    },
    [cancel],
  );

  useEffect(() => cancel, [cancel]);

  return useMemo(() => ({ start, cancel }), [start, cancel]);
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-roving-focus.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';

export type Orientation = 'vertical' | 'horizontal' | 'both';

const isDisabled = (el: HTMLElement) =>
  el.hasAttribute('disabled') || el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true' || el.hasAttribute('data-disabled');

/**
 * Arrow-key focus movement across items inside a container, with Home/End
 * and typeahead. Spread the returned handler on the container:
 *   const onKeyDown = useRovingFocus({ itemSelector: '[role="menuitem"]' });
 *   <div role="menu" onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>…</div>
 */
export function useRovingFocus({
  itemSelector,
  orientation = 'vertical',
  loop = true,
  typeahead = true,
  onMove,
}: {
  itemSelector: string;
  orientation?: Orientation;
  loop?: boolean;
  typeahead?: boolean;
  onMove?: (item: HTMLElement) => void;
}) {
  const buffer = useRef('');
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);

  return useCallback(
    (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
      const items = Array.from(e.currentTarget.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(itemSelector)).filter(
        (el) => !isDisabled(el) && el.getClientRects().length > 0,
      );
      if (!items.length) return;
      const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
      const index = items.findIndex((el) => el === active || (active !== null && el.contains(active)));
      const go = (item: HTMLElement | undefined) => {
        if (!item) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        item.focus();
        onMove?.(item);
      };
      const step = (delta: number) => {
        if (index === -1) return items[delta > 0 ? 0 : items.length - 1];
        let next = index + delta;
        if (loop) next = (next + items.length) % items.length;
        else next = Math.max(0, Math.min(items.length - 1, next));
        return items[next];
      };
      const v = orientation !== 'horizontal';
      const h = orientation !== 'vertical';
      switch (e.key) {
        case 'ArrowDown':
          if (v) go(step(1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          if (v) go(step(-1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          if (h) go(step(1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          if (h) go(step(-1));
          return;
        case 'Home':
          go(items[0]);
          return;
        case 'End':
          go(items[items.length - 1]);
          return;
      }
      if (!typeahead || e.key.length !== 1 || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
      if ((e.target as HTMLElement).matches('input, textarea')) return;
      clearTimeout(timer.current);
      buffer.current += e.key.toLowerCase();
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        buffer.current = '';
      }, 500);
      go(items.find((el) => (el.textContent ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().startsWith(buffer.current)));
    },
    [itemSelector, orientation, loop, typeahead, onMove],
  );
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/lib/slot.tsx`

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import {
  Children,
  cloneElement,
  forwardRef,
  isValidElement,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type ReactElement,
  type ReactNode,
  type Ref,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from './cn';
import { composeRefs } from './compose-refs';

/**
 * Slot — renders its single child instead of its own element, merging props.
 * Powers `asChild`: <Button asChild><a href="/">Home</a></Button>.
 * Event handlers are chained (child first), className is joined, style merged.
 */
export interface SlotProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  children?: ReactNode;
}

type AnyProps = Record<string, unknown>;

const LAZY = Symbol.for('react.lazy');

/**
 * In React Server Components, children passed into a client component can arrive
 * as lazy references. Unwrap them with React.use (React 19) before cloning.
 */
function resolveLazy(node: ReactNode): ReactNode {
  const maybe = node as { $$typeof?: symbol; _payload?: unknown } | null;
  const use = (React as unknown as { use?: (p: unknown) => ReactNode }).use;
  if (maybe && typeof maybe === 'object' && maybe.$$typeof === LAZY && typeof use === 'function') {
    return use(maybe._payload);
  }
  return node;
}

function mergeProps(slotProps: AnyProps, childProps: AnyProps): AnyProps {
  const merged: AnyProps = { ...slotProps, ...childProps };
  for (const key of Object.keys(slotProps)) {
    const slotValue = slotProps[key];
    const childValue = childProps[key];
    if (/^on[A-Z]/.test(key) && typeof slotValue === 'function' && typeof childValue === 'function') {
      merged[key] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
        (childValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
        (slotValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
      };
    } else if (key === 'className') {
      merged[key] = cn(slotValue as string, childValue as string);
    } else if (key === 'style') {
      merged[key] = { ...(slotValue as object), ...(childValue as object) };
    }
  }
  return merged;
}

export const Slot = forwardRef<HTMLElement, SlotProps>(function Slot({ children, ...props }, ref) {
  const child = resolveLazy(Children.only(resolveLazy(children) as ReactElement));
  if (!isValidElement(child)) return null;
  const element = child as ReactElement<AnyProps & { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }>;
  // React 19 exposes ref as a prop; React 18 keeps it on the element.
  const childRef = (element.props.ref ?? (element as unknown as { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }).ref) as Ref<HTMLElement> | undefined;
  return cloneElement(element, {
    ...mergeProps(props as AnyProps, element.props),
    ref: ref ? composeRefs(ref, childRef) : childRef,
  });
});
```

```css
/* Dropdown menu -------------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-floating ui-menu" role="menu" popover="manual" data-state data-side>
     .ui-menu-label  .ui-menu-separator  .ui-menu-group
     .ui-menu-item  [role=menuitem|menuitemcheckbox|menuitemradio]
        + -destructive  + -inset  + -check (indicator slot)
        parts: .ui-menu-icon .ui-menu-shortcut .ui-menu-indicator .ui-menu-dot .ui-menu-chevron
     States: [data-highlighted] (follows pointer and keyboard), [data-disabled], [data-state]
     Submenu: .ui-menu.ui-menu-sub, trigger .ui-menu-sub-trigger[data-state=open]
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-menu {
    min-width: 8rem;
    width: max-content;
    max-width: calc(100vw - 1rem);
    max-height: calc(100dvh - 1rem);
    overflow-y: auto;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    padding: 4px;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    color: var(--ui-surface-raised-foreground);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-lg);
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    outline: none;
  }
  .ui-menu[data-side="bottom"] { --ui-pop-y: -4px; }
  .ui-menu[data-side="top"] { --ui-pop-y: 4px; }
  .ui-menu[data-state="open"] { animation: ui-pop-in var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-out) both; }
  .ui-menu[data-state="closed"] { animation: ui-pop-out var(--ui-duration-exit) var(--ui-ease-in) both; pointer-events: none; }
  /* line the first item of a submenu up with its trigger (panel padding + border) */
  .ui-menu-sub { margin-top: -5px; }

  .ui-menu-item {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    min-height: 2rem;
    padding: 0 0.5rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    color: inherit;
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    line-height: 1.25rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    cursor: default;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    outline: none;
  }
  .ui-menu-item-inset, .ui-menu-item-check { padding-inline-start: 2rem; }
  .ui-menu-item[data-highlighted],
  .ui-menu-item[data-state="open"].ui-menu-sub-trigger {
    background: var(--ui-accent);
    color: var(--ui-accent-foreground);
  }
  .ui-menu-item[data-disabled] { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

  .ui-menu-item-destructive { color: var(--ui-destructive-text); }
  .ui-menu-item-destructive[data-highlighted] {
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 6%, transparent);
    color: var(--ui-destructive-text);
  }

  .ui-menu-icon {
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
  }
  .ui-menu-icon > svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; }
  .ui-menu-item[data-highlighted] .ui-menu-icon,
  .ui-menu-item-destructive .ui-menu-icon { color: inherit; }

  .ui-menu-shortcut {
    margin-inline-start: auto;
    padding-inline-start: 1.5rem;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }
  .ui-menu-item[data-highlighted] .ui-menu-shortcut {
    color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-accent-foreground) 72%, transparent);
  }

  .ui-menu-indicator {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0.5rem;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
  }
  .ui-menu-dot { width: 0.4375rem; height: 0.4375rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; }

  .ui-menu-chevron { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; margin-inline-start: auto; color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }
  .ui-menu-item[data-highlighted] .ui-menu-chevron,
  .ui-menu-sub-trigger[data-state="open"] .ui-menu-chevron { color: inherit; }

  .ui-menu-label {
    padding: 0.375rem 0.5rem;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    line-height: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .ui-menu-separator { height: 1px; margin: 4px -4px; background: var(--ui-border); }

  /* iOS Safari only dispatches click on elements that look clickable */
  @media (hover: none) {
    .ui-menu-item { cursor: pointer; }
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Account menu** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/dropdown-menu/account.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuGroup, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuRadioGroup, DropdownMenuRadioItem, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuSub, DropdownMenuSubContent, DropdownMenuSubTrigger, DropdownMenuTrigger } from '@/ui/components/dropdown-menu';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

export default function DropdownMenuAccount() {
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState(true);
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState('system');

  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
        <Button variant="outline">
          Ada Lovelace
          <Icon name="chevron-down" />
        </Button>
      </DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuContent className="w-60">
        <DropdownMenuLabel>ada@atlas.example.com</DropdownMenuLabel>
        <DropdownMenuGroup aria-label="Account">
          <DropdownMenuItem icon={<Icon name="user" />} shortcut="⇧⌘P">
            Profile
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuItem icon={<Icon name="credit-card" />} shortcut="⌘B">
            Billing
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuItem icon={<Icon name="settings" />} shortcut="⌘,">
            Settings
          </DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuGroup>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuSub>
          <DropdownMenuSubTrigger icon={<Icon name="users" />}>Invite teammates</DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
          <DropdownMenuSubContent>
            <DropdownMenuItem icon={<Icon name="mail" />}>By email</DropdownMenuItem>
            <DropdownMenuItem icon={<Icon name="link" />}>Copy invite link</DropdownMenuItem>
            <DropdownMenuSeparator />
            <DropdownMenuItem icon={<Icon name="plus" />}>More options…</DropdownMenuItem>
          </DropdownMenuSubContent>
        </DropdownMenuSub>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
          checked={notifications}
          onCheckedChange={setNotifications}
          onSelect={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
        >
          Email notifications
        </DropdownMenuCheckboxItem>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuLabel>Theme</DropdownMenuLabel>
        <DropdownMenuRadioGroup value={theme} onValueChange={setTheme} aria-label="Theme">
          <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="light" onSelect={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
            Light
          </DropdownMenuRadioItem>
          <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="dark" onSelect={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
            Dark
          </DropdownMenuRadioItem>
          <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="system" onSelect={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
            System
          </DropdownMenuRadioItem>
        </DropdownMenuRadioGroup>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuItem icon={<Icon name="log-out" />} variant="destructive">
          Log out
        </DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
}
```
